description: The applier's buildweapon order: two anti-nuke launchers of seat 0, whose seat has a million of each resource and as much storage, so no build step is refused. Launcher b is ordered to build two missiles: its second order list +0x60 holds one BuildWeapon node for slot 0 with a count of 2 (the result reads it back), and its stock byte (unit +0x1E) rises to 1 and then to 2 at the weapon's reload pace while the node's count falls to 0 and the node goes. Launcher c has no order and its stock stays 0.
